t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The person said to find a routine on which gnomes give you certain amounts of mushrooms, they also said they usually go for the gnomes with the bigger hats

vb_textbox.text: I think that it is random for everyone and it is best to go with your gut, but I found there to be certain colored gnomes that felt more rare such as the dark purple that sometimes gave me lots of mushrooms. I would say to get a feel for how many mushrooms certain gnomes are giving you and let that guide you to how to choose. Good luck!
